note: Copilot & AI #24. The owner's own API keys (typed by the owner, not echoed, never written anywhere) and a private working folder C:\MGLab\work\copilot-24 outside the repo holding config.json (real model ids and per-million prices), a copy of samples, copilot-answers.json (Copilot Chat answers collected BY HAND as alex.demo, one new chat per task, unedited, JSON-escaped), results.json, review-sheet.md, review-key.json and scores.json. Decide before recording whether model-written Python runs (--allow-code-exec, restricted runner, not a security boundary) or is skipped, and tell the viewer. Cost depends on the models chosen (not verified): set low spending limits in each vendor console. Whatever Copilot answers is the take; if every AI scores 1.00 on a task add a harder one before publishing. Score the review sheet for real (1 to 5) BEFORE opening review-key.json. A screen that needs a second capture of another kind lists it under 'then'.
prepare: if (-not (Test-Path C:\MGLab\work\copilot-24\config.json)) { Copy-Item src/samples/config.json C:\MGLab\work\copilot-24\config.json; Copy-Item src/samples C:\MGLab\work\copilot-24\samples -Recurse -Force }

if (Select-String -Path C:\MGLab\work\copilot-24\config.json -Pattern 'REPLACE-' -Quiet) { throw 'Edit C:\MGLab\work\copilot-24\config.json first: the four REPLACE- model ids (claude, gpt, gemini, local from ollama list) and the real per-million prices' }
if (-not $env:OPENAI_API_KEY) { $env:OPENAI_API_KEY = Read-Host 'OpenAI API key (owner types, not echoed)' -AsSecureString | ConvertFrom-SecureString -AsPlainText }
if (-not $env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) { $env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = Read-Host 'Anthropic API key (owner types, not echoed)' -AsSecureString | ConvertFrom-SecureString -AsPlainText }
if (-not $env:GEMINI_API_KEY) { $env:GEMINI_API_KEY = Read-Host 'Gemini API key (owner types, not echoed)' -AsSecureString | ConvertFrom-SecureString -AsPlainText }

Push-Location C:\MGLab\work\copilot-24; python -m five_ais plan --config config.json --tasks samples/tasks.json; if (-not (Test-Path copilot-answers.json)) { python -m five_ais prompts --config config.json --tasks samples/tasks.json --write-template copilot-answers.json }; Pop-Location

# manual (owner): in Copilot Chat as alex.demo open a NEW chat for each task, paste the printed prompt text, copy Copilot's answer UNEDITED into copilot-answers.json (note date and time); plan must show OK for claude, gpt, gemini and local

# manual (owner): ollama running with the model from episode 23 (http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1); safety take: python -m five_ais run --config config.json --tasks samples/tasks.json --out safety.json --allow-code-exec

screens.name: chat-api-licence
steps: Open Overview of the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat API (preview)
Scroll so both the title with (preview) and the Licensing section are visible
Show: available to users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on licence; support without it is not currently available
Pause three seconds; Microsoft's own page, unedited
mask: any signed-in account avatar in the browser window

screens.name: copilot-chat
steps: Open Microsoft Copilot Chat as alex.demo (no Copilot add-on) and start a NEW chat
Paste the printed prompt of the policy-unanswerable or invoice-json task (python -m five_ais prompts ...)
Show Copilot's real answer; no regeneration unless the first attempt errored
If web search is on for the account, say so on camera
mask: account e-mail in the account menu

screens.name: run
commands: python -m five_ais run --config config.json --tasks samples/tasks.json --out results.json --allow-code-exec
mask: the three API keys are never printed (check the terminal history and prompt)
screens.note: Progress lines per provider and task, the scorecard (mean score, full passes, errors, seconds, tokens, cost), the per-category table and the Errors and Failed checks lists. Real output only; if a provider errored show it as it is. Drop --allow-code-exec to show the skipped rows instead if that was decided.

screens.name: blind-review
steps: Open C:\MGLab\work\copilot-24\review-sheet.md (made by python -m five_ais blind results.json) at one task with answers labelled A to E and no provider names
Show it split beside the terminal; the human scores (1 to 5) were entered before the take WITHOUT opening review-key.json
In the terminal the unblind report shows the human score column filled
mask: tenant name and account e-mail if any appear
prepare: if (-not (Test-Path C:\MGLab\work\copilot-24\results.json)) { throw 'Record the run scene first (results.json is needed)' }
Push-Location C:\MGLab\work\copilot-24; if (-not (Test-Path review-sheet.md)) { python -m five_ais blind results.json }; Pop-Location

then.name: blind-review-unblind
commands: python -m five_ais unblind results.json --key review-key.json --scores scores.json
then.note: Workdir is the private working folder; scores.json holds the owner's real scores.

teardown: Remove-Item Env:OPENAI_API_KEY, Env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, Env:GEMINI_API_KEY, Env:PYTHONPATH -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

# manual (owner): ollama stop <model>; delete the Copilot Chat conversations created for the recording from alex.demo's history; revoke or delete any API key created only for the recording and undo spending-limit changes you no longer need; clear the terminal so the key variables disappear
needs: licence:none (alex.demo has no Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on)
